title: Wire Requires LlamiATMons
description: A modpack with required tech and camera mods needed to play on the modded LlamiDonka server.
body:
## Main Features:
- Fully functional programable computers and robots from Computer Craft.
- Film and instant cameras that let you capture important moments during your adventure and, optionally, developing the film for images to display in the world for others to see.
- Addons for Create (Create Deco and Create: Steam N Rails)
- Better recipes for Computer Craft computers.
- And more!

### Singleplayer or Multiplayer? 
This modpack is required to play on the modded LlamiDonka server, but can also be played in singleplayer!
